title: Traverse Platform Embedder API
description: Uniform thin platform embedder contract. Same semantics on iOS, Android, web, Windows, Linux, and CLI. Governs spec 057-embeddable-runtime-host; app-command submit envelopes governed by spec 139-embedder-app-state-machine-execution.

input.manifest_bundle_path: string — app-bundled manifests + wasm artifacts root

fields.session_id: string | null — optional; omitted starts a new session

runtime.submit.discrimination: Fail closed if the payload is ambiguous between forms.

runtime.subscribe.note: Event data JSON MUST match 033-http-json-api SSE data payload shape where applicable. Saga terminal events follow spec 139.

rules: No platform-specific operations beyond this set.
No business logic in embedder implementations.
JSON wire format for all payloads in v1.
App state-machine transitions execute inside runtime.wasm (spec 139); embedder forwards commands and events only.
Conformance suite in scripts/ci/embedder_conformance/ MUST pass for certification.
